entries.47ef93680240aa22: Subsidiaries in China and Taiwan, such as Shanghai Toyo Tanso Co., Ltd., Shanghai Toyo Tanso Industry Co., Ltd., Toyo Tanso (Zhejiang) Co., Ltd., Chengdu Toyo Tanso Industry Co., Ltd. and Seiko Tanso Co., Ltd., are responsible for manufacturing and sales of carbon products. External customer sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥12,477 million.
entries.a67d51cb89f48017: TOYO TANSO USA, INC. is responsible for manufacturing and sales of carbon products. External customer sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥4,618 million.
entries.afb984bd434494d4: A company that manufactures and processes carbon products made from isotropic graphite material and sells them directly to customers in Japan and overseas.
entries.d4cd241f0f0976a8: TOYO TANSO EUROPE S.P.A. (Italy), TOYO TANSO FRANCE S.A. (France) and GTD GRAPHIT TECHNOLOGIE GMBH (Germany) are responsible for manufacturing, processing and sales of carbon products. External customer sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥4,908 million.
entries.d7d3ead72a9367e3: The company, Tōtan Kakō and Ōwada Carbon Kōgyō are responsible for manufacturing and sales of special graphite products, general carbon products (machinery carbon field) and composite materials and other products, and also sell general carbon products (electrical carbon field). External customer sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥24,184 million.
